alt.en: A worn printed book page numbered 56 and headed "Ar hŷd y nos": a short song for voice and harp with Welsh and English words under the notes, then several lines of harp variations.
alt.es: Una página de libro impresa y gastada, con el número 56 y el encabezado "Ar hŷd y nos": una breve canción para voz y arpa, con letra galesa e inglesa bajo las notas, y después varias líneas de variaciones para arpa.

caption.en: Page 56 of Edward Jones's Musical and Poetical Relicks of the Welsh Bards (London, 1784), the earliest known printing of the air, set for voice and harp with one verse in Welsh and one in English.
caption.es: La página 56 de Musical and Poetical Relicks of the Welsh Bards, de Edward Jones (Londres, 1784), la primera impresión conocida del aire, escrito para voz y arpa con una estrofa en galés y otra en inglés.

source: Edward Jones, Musical and Poetical Relicks of the Welsh Bards (London: printed for the author, 1784), p. 56, "Ar hŷd y nos"
library: The Johns Hopkins University Sheridan Libraries, Bibliotheca Fictiva collection (digitized by the Internet Archive)
callNumber: JHU record 4103341; Internet Archive bib_fict_4103341, image n73 (printed page 56)
licenceEvidence: Printed London 1784; Edward Jones died 1824; the music engraver is not named. Public domain in the US (published before 1931), the EU and Israel (life plus 70 ended 1894). Photograph of a flat page.
credit: The Johns Hopkins University Sheridan Libraries, via the Internet Archive

alt.en: A tall wooden harp with a dark red-brown body flecked with gold, a scrolled neck and many strings, standing on a plain pale background.
alt.es: Un arpa alta de madera, de cuerpo rojo oscuro con motas doradas, cuello en voluta y muchas cuerdas, sobre un fondo claro y liso.

caption.en: A Welsh triple harp made about 1750 by John Richards of Llanrwst, north Wales; Edward Jones, himself a harper, set Ar hŷd y nos for voice and harp, with five harp variations.
caption.es: Un arpa triple galesa hecha hacia 1750 por John Richards, de Llanrwst, en el norte de Gales; Edward Jones, que también era arpista, publicó Ar hŷd y nos para voz y arpa, con cinco variaciones para arpa.

source: Welsh Triple Harp, John Richards (maker), Llanrwst, about 1750 (wood, various materials)
library: The Metropolitan Museum of Art, New York, The Crosby Brown Collection of Musical Instruments, 1889
